packages.name: Kobee Studio
packages.description: Create PCB labels, symbols, component callouts, header overlays, QR Codes, and barcodes inside KiCad
packages.description_full: Kobee Studio creates editable PCB artwork on silkscreen, copper, and solder-mask layers. It includes parametric labels with optional underlines, PCB symbols, searchable presets, component callouts and arrays, configurable 2.54 mm header overlays, QR Codes, Code 128 barcodes, and optional readable text beneath machine codes. Kobee Studio evolved from KiBuzzard by Greg Davill. Version 1.3.4 is the current stable release tested with KiCad 10 on macOS and Windows. Version 1.4 is the active testing stream for the redesigned Kobee Studio editor.
